written_by: Claude (ES and PT landing page lists added)
summary:
Web-shop purchases from the Sage Active checkout still do not fire the Floodlight lead tag in DE, FR and ES (global incident, pending EU set-up with MarTech). DE also loses web-shop trials.
New today: the ES (11) and PT (6) paid media URL lists are in. All 17 pages answer without redirects. Their 53 lead forms (31 ES, 22 PT) are active, and every submit fires Floodlight (ES 36, PT 402) with the matching lead-type tag, Google Ads, LinkedIn and Meta.
Also new: a Tealium publish on the ciel.com profile (FR) added Floodlight tag 17 for shop purchases. Purchases there now fire tags 9 and 17.
Still open: AT form conversions cannot fire (GTM trigger needs a button ID the forms do not have), and www.ciel.com has no cookie banner.

CONV-01:ecom_buy.summary: One shared cause: the Floodlight lead tags need ga4_customer_lead_type, which Tealium only sets for lead forms, and the Sage Active checkout does not send it.

DE.summary: Lead forms, purchases and all 136 forms work; web-shop trials and purchases are not counted as leads.

items.text: Web-shop trials do not fire Floodlight 98.
Web-shop purchases do not fire Floodlight 98.
One HR form name starts with a space, so Floodlight 389 cannot fire for it.

CONV-01:ecom_try|market.text: Tag 98 needs ga4_customer_lead_type (rule 274, added with the Tealium publish of 24 Aug 2026). Tealium derives it only from lead form names; the checkout sends customer_lead_type=ecom_try without one. Before the publish the tag fired. Fix: map customer_lead_type to ga4_customer_lead_type for web-shop events, or drop rule 274 from tag 98.

CONV-01:ecom_buy|market.text: Same cause as web-shop trials (rule 274 on tag 98).

FORM-02|form:HCM_2701_NCA_DE_HRReadyNCAB.text: The form's lastContentName starts with a space (' CL_HCM_DE_MED_CON_BOFU_HRReadyNCABeratung'). Load rule 331 checks the start of the name, so Floodlight 389 never fires for this form. Fix: remove the space in the Gated Content gate.

AT.summary: Pages, consent and page-view tags work on sagedpw.at, but form submits cannot fire the Floodlight conversion.

items.text: Floodlight sage_012 waits for a click on a button with 'Submit' in its ID; the form buttons have no ID.
items.action: Fix the GTM trigger or the buttons.

items.text: Floodlight sage_013 waits for a click on the DPW to GO order PDF; no checked page links to it.

brief.title: Working
items: Usercentrics banner; nothing fires before consent.
Floodlight page views, GA4 and gclid on all landing and form pages.

GTM-07|conversion:sage_012.text: GTM-PS6MXC v13: sageg0/sage_012 fires on gtm.click where Click ID contains 'Submit'. The submit inputs on /kontaktformular/ and /kostenloses-infopaket/ have no id, so the trigger never matches. Fix: trigger on the form's success event or thank-you page, or give the buttons an id containing 'Submit'.

GTM-07|conversion:sage_013.text: sageg0/sage_013 fires on a click on a link to uploads/SageDPWtoGO_Bestellformular_neu_3503_DE.pdf. None of the paid landing pages or form pages link to it. Check whether the PDF is still offered; if not, the tag is obsolete.
